headline: Arhan canli leaps into ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: Arhan canli climbed 802 places, from 826th to 24th, reaching 43.33 after a 12.77-point gain.
The move puts Arhan inside the 15 gold places on the public board, where the current line is 48.75. Those places remain provisional.
